final: WITH grouped AS (SELECT transref, AVG(anlycount) AS avg_analysts FROM sentimentandfundamentals GROUP BY transref), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_analysts) AS avg_analysts FROM grouped), above AS (SELECT g.transref, g.avg_analysts, g.avg_analysts - o.avg_analysts AS difference FROM grouped AS g CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE o.avg_analysts IS NOT NULL AND g.avg_analysts > o.avg_analysts), above_avg AS (SELECT AVG(avg_analysts) AS avg_analysts FROM above) SELECT a.transref, a.avg_analysts, a.difference, a.avg_analysts - b.avg_analysts FROM above AS a CROSS JOIN above_avg AS b WHERE b.avg_analysts IS NOT NULL ORDER BY a.avg_analysts - b.avg_analysts DESC LIMIT 10
